text: The test restarts Thunderbird with one replay URL, checks the 3pane window type and asks the registered observer service for the recorded URL. Those two equality assertions have no message. This covers the command-line delivery path in test code; it does not directly click a web link, install a handler or validate another component URL. No Marionette or platform run occurred.
title: The net.thunderbird replay test checks CLI delivery rather than OS registration
